create_linear_baseline: create a LinearBaseline instance with env_spec and optional input type and regularization coefficient
fit_linear_baseline: fit the LinearBaseline model to trajectory paths using regularized least squares regression
predict_baseline_values: predict baseline values for a single trajectory path using fitted LinearBaseline coefficients
extract_features_from_paths: extract linear and time polynomial features from trajectory paths for baseline fitting
review_linear_baseline_class: review the LinearBaseline class and its fit and predict methods for value baseline estimation
